scope: All newly proposed same-taxon size/stage allocations for the nine assigned selected model-region pairs. Searches performed before finalizing catch proxies.
outcome: No observed caught-mass fractions adopted. This bounded public-source search did find size/age observations and assessment methods; none was established as a compatible whole-region, catch-basis and exact model-cutoff distribution. Absence of an adopted fraction is not a claim that raw sampling data do not exist.

queries: Chile hoki Macruronus magellanicus catch age composition 1980 2024 IFOP stock assessment

sources.region_period_gear: Chilean fishery sampling portal; species/year/port selection required; fleet not selected
sources.result: Portal describes length/biological data availability, but retrieved page does not expose a weighted catch-age mass table.

sources.region_period_gear: Chilean Patagonian grenadier age/length assessment; data through December 2013; model starts 1985
sources.result: Age/length structured assessment is available, but retrieved article material does not give a whole-Humboldt caught-mass split at <3 / >=3 years. Patagonia study-area mismatch remains.

sources.region_period_gear: Chile 2025 stock advice; hoki maturity reference
sources.result: Maturity/selectivity reference is not observed catch composition for the 1980 model or whole Humboldt LME.

records.decision: Use documented model Hoki juvenile/adult landings proxy after search; do not claim observed regional age fractions.

sources.region_period_gear: Celtic Sea 7e-k; CEFAS/Marine Institute trawl surveys and fishery landings, 1980s-2000s
sources.result: Cod maturation varies across ages 2-5; survey maturity is not a catch mass fraction. Retained EwE stage definitions lack a numerical cutoff; no arbitrary maturity cutoff adopted.

sources.region_period_gear: Northern hake stock across 3a/4/6/7/8abd; assessment 2024, time series from 1978
sources.result: Stock totals, recruitment and F ages are available, not whole-LME catch mass at the model's undefined juvenile/adult boundary.

sources.region_period_gear: Northern hake multifleet 2004 prediction; stock spans Celtic Sea and adjacent regions
sources.result: Search recovered Table 3.15 catch-at-age numbers and weights, but it is forecast output for a wider stock, not observed whole-LME distribution; direct open returned Internal Error. No predicted age fractions adopted.
Stock totals and age-0 recruitment are not juvenile/adult catch shares.

sources.region_period_gear: White-bellied anglerfish catch sampling in Shetland, west of Scotland and Rockall; article 2008
sources.result: Length frequencies by sampled area are reported, but geography differs and percentages are fish counts, not mass at a documented model stage cutoff. Not adopted.

records.decision: Use explicit assumed 1985 model total-catch shares; preserve source stage names without inventing age/length threshold or gear. Same Lophius pool stage share applied to each explicitly included species is a stated assumption.

sources.result: Catch-at-age assessment inputs exist. Area is a Mediterranean sub-basin; sardine input age-matrix uncertainty is explicitly reported. No whole-basin observed mass composition recovered.

sources.region_period_gear: Northern/central Adriatic anchovy; 1975-2005; shared national fleets
sources.result: Length-frequency and age-length data were combined for assessment; this describes method and a regional subset, not directly applicable basin-wide Adult/Recruit mass fractions.
Adriatic stock assessment, not basin-wide sampling; no model-compatible cutoff mass split retrieved.

sources.region_period_gear: Mediterranean operational units; hake/mullet assessments 1994-1999; trawl and catch assessment surveys
sources.result: Contains sampling and recruitment descriptions, including red-mullet post-recruitment season. Does not establish total basin catch stage percentages; survey abundance cannot substitute for caught mass.
Age/growth sampling not whole-basin caught-mass proportions; direct open returned Internal Error.

records.decision: Document four assumed model total-catch stage maps only; no numeric SPPR exists. Model adult/recruit cutoffs remain qualitative.

sources.result: Recovered monthly length-based separation of sardine bycatch into age0/age1. Length cutoffs vary by month/year, and raw catch-length inputs plus mass conversion/complete regional fleet coverage would be required. Direct PDF open succeeded; subsequent text find returned tool error. No whole Benguela LME mass split established.

sources.region_period_gear: South African small pelagic fishery; 2023 status report with earlier surveys/landings
sources.result: Confirms commercial catch length sampling exists and distinguishes it from hydroacoustic biomass. Does not provide a directly compatible full-LME age0/>=1 caught-mass matrix in retrieved material.

sources.result: Gear-dependent abundance/selectivity and CPUE described; these are not observed <2/>=2 years mass proportions across the Benguela LME.

sources.result: Generic hake commercial records require species disaggregation. Cannot manufacture M.capensis <3/>=3 mass fractions or resolve generic hake composition.

records.decision: Model recorded catch proxy proposed for sardine, M.capensis and horse mackerel; Engraulis capensis retained as taxonomy-review blocker with conditional source weights in ledger. No observed size fractions adopted.
